smoothoperator2021.notes: Material Menghai fermentado em 2021. Chá com textura muito suave e sedosa, doçura em camadas, notas de cereja escura e cacau cru. Leveza amadeirada e leve amargor quando pressionado. Recomendado fazer 2 lavagens rápidas (~10-15s cada) a 100°C antes das infusões. Excelente custo-benefício para a categoria.
smoothoperator2021.name: Smooth Operator 2021 Menghai Ripe Puer

pioneer2024spring.notes: Zhengshan Xiaozhong (Lapsang Souchong) from Tongmuguan, smoked using stored Masson pine. 2024 spring harvest. Smokiness is pleasant and medium intensity, never harsh or bitter. Notable floral and cherry/stonefruit qualities persist across many infusions. Cup scent offers distinct baked goods/cinnamon bun notes. Brew at full boil (100°C). No wash recommended to preserve the delicate first-infusion smoke aroma.
pioneer2024spring.name: Pioneer 2024 Spring Tongmuguan Zhengshan Xiaozhong Smoked Black Tea
